assumptions: Hypothetical projection: it assumes the stated reduction is achieved over the whole baseline period. It is not measured savings and does not show that any reduction happened.
estimated_savings = baseline x reduction_percentage / 100; projected_consumption = baseline - estimated_savings.
All consumption values are in kWh. The baseline period is 7 days and is never rescaled.
Baseline = 2629.2 kWh forecast over 7 days (2026-07-06 to 2026-07-12) by the Phase 6 forecasting engine (model: seasonal_naive).

Baseline uncertainty: [2629.2, 2629.2] kWh at 80% nominal level using empirical_backtest_residual_quantile (split-conformal style): half-width = the ceil((n+1)*level)-th smallest absolute rolling-origin backtest error of the selected model, per forecast step when the step has enough residuals, otherwise pooled over steps; lower bound clipped at 0.
